system.description:
Favoured weapon: Maul

Granted power: Advantage on Tracking checks. Once/day: speak with plants and animals for 10 minutes. Once per encounter, a creature you hit with your maul makes a Reflex save or its speed is halved until its next turn.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Silvanus in the World of Arneyan wiki.
